recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中出現大量大型異常細胞，細胞質佈滿粉紫色顆粒，多數核呈雙葉、腎形或折疊狀（butterfly/bilobed nuclei），這是異常前骨髓細胞（abnormal promyelocyte）的典型外觀，提示 APL 中樞神經復發。
features: Numerous large atypical cells, 2-3 times the size of red cells, in a cytocentrifuge CSF preparation
Moderate N:C ratio with folded, reniform, or bilobed (butterfly-shaped) nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Abundant cytoplasm packed with fine to coarse purple-pink azurophilic granules, some granules overlying the nucleus
Occasional cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles; a single small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Background of scattered red cells without significant inflammatory cells
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a markedly cellular specimen composed predominantly of large atypical myeloid cells. The cells have folded, reniform to bilobed (butterfly-shaped) nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm filled with prominent azurophilic granules. Rare small lymphocytes and red cells are present in the background; Auer rod bundles are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with CNS (extramedullary) involvement by acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: The variant shows bilobed nuclei but sparse or invisible granules, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei but grey-blue cytoplasm with fine sparse granules and are strongly NSE positive rather than packed with coarse azurophilic granules.
Blood contamination brings mature segmented neutrophils in proportion to red cells, not a monotonous population of large granular immature cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic meningitis from AML with maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have round nuclei, visible nucleoli and fewer granules; PML::RARA testing or PML nuclear body immunofluorescence confirms APL.
